title: Archytan Lite receipt export
description: The receipts.json file written by archytan-lite --export-chain. Each entry is the receipt as stored, which differs from the receipt returned by /v1/authorize (see receipt.v1.json) in two ways: it includes idempotency_key, because the intent hash covers it and an offline verifier must recompute that hash, and it carries created_at as the exact text stored on disk instead of timestamp. The export directory also holds manifest.json, its signature manifest.sig, a README and the source of a standalone verifier; run that verifier to check signatures and the chain. This schema checks the file's shape only. See internal/receipt/store.go (StoredReceipt).

format.description: Format identifier. Only archytan-lite-receipts-v1 exists today.

receipts.description: Every receipt in the gate's chain, in sequence order, ALLOW and BLOCK alike.

seq.description: Position in the chain, starting at 1.

receipt_id.description: "rcpt_" followed by 16 random bytes in hex.

action.description: The action that was requested, as named in policy.json.

resource_type.description: The type of the resource the action targets.

resource_id.description: The identifier of the resource the action targets. Cannot be redacted without breaking verification.

actor_uid.description: The actor identifier the caller supplied.

actor_role.description: The role the decision was made against: the credential's role in bound mode, the request body's role in shared-secret mode.

decision.description: The decision. "ESCALATE" is reserved but not emitted.

idempotency_key.description: The request's idempotency key. Part of the signed intent, so it is required to recompute intent_hash.

intent_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the decision's canonical fields.

signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature by the gate's key over the intent hash, under the receipt domain tag.

operator_urn.description: The identity of the gate instance that made the decision.

trace_id.description: Per-request trace identifier, the same value a refused caller receives.

chain_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 link to the receipt before it.

created_at.description: The decision time exactly as stored on disk, RFC 3339 in current versions. Kept as stored text so the export reproduces the stored bytes.
